notes.title: Achievements are LIVE!
notes.content:
After far too long, Postlife now has earnable achievements! ^^
- Some minor environmental changes too...

notes.title: Postlife Demo is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
Happy to announce that Postlife has a demo that's live right now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44949585/f8cde53b18456979f0b0483f3c15e57da452605f.png
It isn't a very long demo, but I hope it can help future fans make the final decision on if they'd like to play the game. I'm super duper thankful to anyone who gives the demo a shot. Thank you for your time. ^^
